_comment: Tier-4 heal -- the legendary capstone. Theriac was the universal remedy of antiquity, prepared by long compounding and reputed to cure all wounds. Unlocked only after sustained Electuary practice. Per [[project_healing_system_locked_2026_06_14]] -- do NOT slot anything above this.
name: Theriac
description: A dense block the colour of dried blood and old honey. The scent is layered: forest floor, resin, lichen long since dried -- and beneath those, something the senses refuse to name. A grain on the tongue is enough.
